review.note: Wrong event. EO 902 (July 2, 1908) diminished the Sierra to form the Sequoia and parts of other forests; it did not establish the Sierra. The Sierra Forest Reserve was established by Benjamin Harrison, Proclamation of Feb. 14, 1893 (No. 43), 27 Stat. 1059. (Davis misprints the volume as 26.)
